game_concept: A racing platformer set in Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter, a smelter processing glowing ore: the lava scout must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Rounding Range: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Ore Smelter: a smelter processing glowing ore
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Smelter, repeat each round: Use round() and abs() to snap messy measurements into valid slots. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the lava scout ahead. Then check the slot_matches value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the fire shrine by solving code steps involving slot_matches that move the lava scout forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the fire shrine first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Rounding Range
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Rounding Range' (Week 2 slot 13), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Ore Smelter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slot_matches changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Ore Smelter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.1).
